spiritgiven.comments: Thank you for sorting out timekeeping and volunteer situation to run things smoothly! Also we are very appreciative of the clean non-contact play and your great energy!

Thank you for the intensity and fire in this game! A couple of points to work on: 1. On a few occasions the sideline jumped in after calls have been resolved. 2. Using hand signals and making resolutions clear. 
We appreciate you adapting to signaling players gender to help matching people up on the lines.

Gracias for the wonderfully positive game! We were really impressed that you remembered all our names and always smiling, cheering both teams throughout this very intense game! Nothing new to add, only the two points we mentioned in the circle about travels (changing direction, changing the pivot and accelerating after the two steps to stop), and fast count. We enjoyed the game, the passion you put in and look forward to meeting you again! Maybe for a dance off too!
Thank you so much for adapting so readily to our request of shoulder tapping! Great spirit throughout!

Thanks for discussing with us the things we felt could be improved - our concerns were based on the second half of the game: awareness to avoid dangerous play, disregarding observers opinions without a good reason/argument, jumping in too early to give suggestions, comments and observations about play from the sideline. Aside from that we had a great time with you on the sideline and with those few things resolved we're looking forward to meet you again in the future for another fantastic game

Great positivity and proactive chats on the sideline. We felt there are a couple of areas of improvement as we mentioned in the spirit circle: Rules knowledge, push off contact on the male side, better communication on the field using hand signals, timeliness of discussions and seeking resolution within 45 seconds, moving any further conversations to the sideline after the point if necessary.

Thank you for this wonderfully positive game, for looking after us with suncream and water and free hugs! Everything was awesome! The only feedback for both teams is to use hand signals more regularly and inform the rest of the players and sideline of calls before the discussions happen. Good luck with your other games!
It was a class act and a very pleasant game!

There were a number of rules that we felt you didn't know and you used the rules to your advantage throughout the game. Calls were retracted by you when we turned over but we were told by you that we couldn't retract calls when you turned over which is an inconsistent application of the rules. Your sideline was quick to contribute to calls verbally and with gestures before being invited into the discussion. We felt your body contact was good and we had many positive interactions on the sideline.
Exemplary! Watch the game and you'll see what we mean! Muchas gracias, Co-co-colombia!
We saw an improvement in some areas. Awareness and avoiding dangerous situations and contact on the field needs to be addressed as well as being open to perspective.
Thank you Australia for such a wonderful game to close the tournament! We hope to play you again!

spiritreceived.comments: We’re glad we had good communication. Thank you for praising my good play. Thank you for praising our good play.

Thank you GB for a competitive game. A few comments on inconsistent levels of contact acceptance within the team, and overall positive attitude was great but self-control could be improved from people both on the field and the sideline. But overall we really enjoyed the game. Thank you for your discussions and we will work on those points going forward.

Overall the sideline and on field communication did not feel spirited. There were a couple of instances where the chat after a call was not calm. 
Some calls that were held or retracted seemed in favor of their team and there were instances of excessive calls being made that didn't impact play.
There was some disagreement over rule knowledge and use, but we think overall they knew their rules well.
Thanks GB, that was a very enjoyable game. We loved the positive energy, willingness to hear our perspectives and fair mind. So refreshing!
Thank you for a great game. We had a wonderful time and enjoyed the great spirit, communication and sideline presence in the stadium. Fern has a great banner and everyone should see it.

Thank you for the game! There were a couple of times where a clarification for the rules was needed. We encourage the team to use the hand signals to help the smoothness of the game. Even though most of our team speaks English, it’s not our first language and the hand signals help to avoid miscommunication. Please, avoid as well getting involve in the calls.
[adjusted by spirit director per COL request]

There were several stoppages due to calls that seemed unjustified, with multiple misinterpretations of the rules. We encourage you to have a conversation with some of your players about the SOTG, specifically #90, who was rude and celebrated in an unfriendly manner towards our player over our mistakes. Please be more receptive to our feedback. Although we regularly communicate with the spirit captains, they often took the stance that their calls were right.
